instruction: Complete the financial model based on the provided assumptions. Ensure the existing structure, layout, and formatting of the model are preserved throughout the process. In the Revenue & COGS Schedule sheet, calculate other expenses / operating and manufacturing expenses for FY23E-FY25E. In the BS Schedules sheet, calculate Tax Expense for FY22E-FY25E, Interest Expense for FY22E-FY25E, Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) as percentages of Sales, and then Inventory as a % of COGS for all periods. In the Ratios sheet, calculate EBIT Margin for the forecast period.
